paragraphs: Jacobs is a global professional services company that delivers consulting and advisory, design and implementation work across infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, environmental and technology challenges. The sectors listed on these pages include transport across airports, rail, roads and maritime, water, buildings, power transmission and distribution, and land use planning. Building solutions cover the planning, design, delivery and operation of buildings, from strategy and planning through design, delivery, operations and reinvestment.

A digital and AI line combines artificial intelligence, digital advisory and enterprise software for organizations that plan, build and operate infrastructure. Intelligent O&M applies AI-driven analytics to wastewater and drinking water treatment plants, predicting failures and optimizing processes. StreetLight applies location-based analytics to show how people and goods move, for planning and operating decisions across transportation networks.

Clients named on these pages include the Central Utah Water Conservancy District, which selected Jacobs for engineering services on the proposed Strawberry High Line Improvement Project. The Orange County Transportation Authority selected Jacobs for construction management on two highway improvement projects in Orange County, California. Tilt Renewables selected Jacobs as owner's engineer for the Palmer Wind Farm near Adelaide, South Australia.

quote.text: Jacobs combines artificial intelligence (AI), digital advisory and enterprise software to enable our clients to plan, build and operate with confidence.
